title: Feature request: scan only selected items or items in view
body:
As explained in #1, this plugin always scans all records.

In large libraries with remote attachments, can be a long and costly operation (cost due to retrieving objects).

There could be an option to only scan the object of the selected items or all the items in the current (filtered) view.
author: gvlx

comments.body:
Added since v0.2.0. 
Select items, right-click, and select `Scan Attachments of Selected Items` from the popup menu.

title: Non-desired tags when plugin is installled on several PC with synced database
body:
Hi
I use Zotero on several Pcs, on which I installed attachment-scanner. My database in synchronized.
It seems that a scan has been operated quickly after the plugin installation (I installed the plugin at the very opening of application)  : non-desired tags  (all three categories and with default simpole format) appeared since I had scanned previously on another PC with non-default options. I guess this scan is triggered by the monitoring option which is set as on by default. If so and if I'm not wrong perhaps would it be more secure to set it as off by default ?
This is not a great problem since tags can be easily removed.
Best regards
Yves
author: ynedelec3

comments.body: The default is changed to off in v0.3.0. Thanks!

title: 关于优化附件重复附件检查功能建议
body:
首先感谢开发者的这个插件，给了我们很多便利！
然后，我有一个优化建议，望能采纳！
目前的重复附件检查，一个条目下只要有两个附件就会判定为重复，但是我有的条目下有论文pdf以及它的支撑材料SI文件，这种能否通过附件大小不同或者名称不同，来判定并非重复附件。
以上，感谢！
author: chengwenlong2008

comments.body:
In this case, the files are duplicates by definition and should be tagged accordingly.
File size is not a reliable criterion. While adding a file name filter is possible, it requires further consideration. It is completely against the purpose of Zotero's auto-rename function.

It is indeed important to distinguish whether multiple PDF files under an item are duplicates or a collection of original articles, supplementary materials, and peer opinions. Sometimes, there are even multiple images, tables, documents, etc. in the supplementary materials. I really hope to enhance the duplicate attachment checking function to meet potential application needs.
File name masks were introduced in v0.3.0.

title: Scan cancel does not work in error conditions
body: As in #4 , there might be _other_ error cases where the cancel action is unable to interrupt the scan.
author: gvlx

comments.body: Please add some instructions on how to debug the case.

On 0.3.0 it now scans my 9047 attachments in less than a minute. :)

Either I've solved the malignant attachment I had, or the code is now more robust.

Great! I don't think the code is now more robust. On my computer, it still scans at 200 items/second.
In fact, due to the new functions and error checking, it should be slower. Although the difference may not be noticeable.

title: Plugin can't be stopped
body: There's no option or command to cancel the scan, which is useful when scanning too many records.
author: gvlx

comments.body:
v 0.2.0, as you wished
- A "Cancel Attachment Scanning" menu item is now available in the “Tools” menu.

title: Plugin always scans all records
body:
Expected to scan only shown or selected records.

Always scans the entire library.
author: gvlx

comments.body:
v 0.2.0:
- A **popup** menu item labeled "Scan Attachments of Selected Items" has been added.
- The caption for the item in the main "Tools" menu has been updated to "Scan All Attachments" to clarify that it applies to all items.
